backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual operating_income and revenue are known by SEC filed date (<= signal date). Current operating income is matched to same-period current revenue; prior annual operating income is matched to same-period prior revenue. Both prior and current operating margins must be positive to avoid loss-to-profit base effects. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

runtime_fields: SEC companyfacts filed date and period end

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool: PIT SEC Companyfacts annual operating leverage acceleration, where revenue grows and operating income grows faster than revenue, paired with liquid SPY-relative confirmation, may identify incremental-margin leaders with better 10d paper replacement value than static profitability or asset-growth variants.

2_history_check.exp-20260528-004: Positive latest quarterly operating income was tested inside the older Fundamental Growth RS source and later required a closed ledger governor; this run is not a static positive-profit filter.
2_history_check.exp-20260528-023: Operating-margin durability support was rejected. This run tests annual operating-income growth outpacing revenue growth as a standalone default-off candidate source, not non-declining margin support within an accepted sleeve.
2_history_check.exp-20260605-026: Loss-to-profit inflection was rejected. This run requires positive prior and current operating margin, so it excludes pure loss-to-profit base effects.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-031/exp-20260614-014/exp-20: Operating-income/assets, broad Kova capital efficiency, and gross profitability were rejected. This run tests growth-through-margin acceleration rather than static profitability level or asset efficiency.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and the accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Prior static operating-profit, operating-margin durability, operating-income/assets, and broad Kova quality variants failed or required governors. Dynamic operating leverage is a more targeted incremental-margin hypothesis, but the Companyfacts quality family is crowded and the odds of comparator or drawdown failure are high.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing annual operating_income/revenue pair, missing prior annual comparison pair, stale facts, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same PIT annual operating-leverage acceleration gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
